name: kalanso-desktop
description: Kalanso — application desktop de gestion d'école (direction Indigo Minuit)
author: Kalanso

scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:app && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:linux:publish: npm run build:app && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish always
scripts.dist:win:publish: npm run build:app && WINEPREFIX="$HOME/.cache/electron-builder/wine-home" electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
scripts.dist:all:publish: npm run build:app && WINEPREFIX="$HOME/.cache/electron-builder/wine-home" electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --win nsis --publish always
